# Glossary

The uncommon terms the ᝯㄝₓ plugins use: Stash's own first, then this repo's. Each is a word Stash
or these plugins use in a sense of their own. Where one appears in a plugin's settings, in the head
of one of its dialogs or in a README, it is underlined once, and hovering or tapping it shows what
it means here.

## Stash's terms

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="entity"></a>entity, entities | One item in a Stash library - a scene, image, gallery, performer, studio, group, tag or scene marker. |
| <a id="entity-type"></a>entity-type | Which kind of entity an item is - scene, image, gallery, performer, studio, group, tag or scene marker. Much here is set, searched or run per entity-type. |
| <a id="stash-box"></a>stash-box, stashdb | A shared online database of scene, performer and studio metadata that Stash matches against and scrapes from; StashDB is the best-known one. |
| <a id="stash-id"></a>stash-id | The link from an entity in your library to its entry on a stash-box: the box's address and the entry's id. |
| <a id="organized"></a>organized | Stash's per-scene, image and gallery flag saying you have finished organizing it. |
| <a id="auto-tagging"></a>auto-tagging | Stash's Auto Tag task: it tags scenes, images and galleries with performers, studios and tags whose names appear in the file paths. |
| <a id="tagger"></a>tagger | Stash's Scene Tagger, which matches scenes against a stash-box. |
| <a id="marker"></a>marker | A scene marker: a moment in a scene (a time, and optionally an end), with a title, a primary tag and other tags. |
| <a id="group"></a>group, sub-group | A group (formerly a movie) collects scenes in order; a group can hold other groups, its sub-groups. |
| <a id="parent"></a>parent, ancestor, descendant, hierarchy, hierarchies, multi-parent | Tags nest: a tag's parents and sub-tags, and everything above (ancestors) or below (descendants) it. |

## This repo's terms

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="reaction"></a>reaction, react | A plugin's automatic response to a save you just made in Stash - auto-propagation, auto-prune. |
| <a id="auto-mode"></a>auto-mode | A plugin's reaction to every save, switched on per entity type: Normalize Parent Tags' Auto-Prune and Auto-Roll-Up, Propagate's two directions. |
| <a id="propagate"></a>propagate, auto-propagation | Propagate Tags and Performers copying tags or performers from one entity to related ones. |
| <a id="depropagate"></a>depropagate | The Depropagate assist: offers to remove tags a save left behind when it removed their source. |
| <a id="never-propagate"></a>never-propagate | The mark on a tag that keeps the merge and propagate plugins from copying it. |
| <a id="auto-merge"></a>auto-merge | Merge Performer Tags merging a performer's tags onto their scenes whenever a scene or performer is saved. |
| <a id="prune"></a>prune, pruned | Normalize Parent Tags removing a tag an entity already carries through a more specific one. |
| <a id="roll-up"></a>roll-up | Normalize Parent Tags adding the parents implied by an entity's tags. |
| <a id="redundancy"></a>redundancy, redundant | A tag implied by a more specific one on the same entity. |
| <a id="variant"></a>variant, multi-variant | Scene Variants: scenes that are the same content - a full version and its trailers or cuts. |
| <a id="full-duration"></a>full-duration | Scene Variants: a variant that is the whole work, not a cut out of it - told by the Full-duration tag. |
| <a id="partial-duration"></a>partial-duration | Scene Variants: a variant that is a cut out of the whole work - a trailer, a promo, a clip - told by the Partial-duration tag. |
| <a id="base-title"></a>base-title | The title a variant set's partials are named after. |
| <a id="postfix"></a>postfix | What follows the base-title in a partial's title, before its index: " - Promo ". |
| <a id="pseudo-stash-id"></a>pseudo-stash-id | A stand-in stash-id Scene Variants writes to group scenes that no stash-box knows. |
| <a id="drift-score"></a>drift-score | How far a variant set's members have moved apart - tags, performers, cover and other attributes - each difference priced by a weight. |
| <a id="store"></a>store | The tag Custom Fields Bulk Editor keeps the custom-field descriptions in. |
| <a id="lock"></a>lock, locked | A custom field locked in Custom Fields Bulk Editor: added to, never changed or removed. |
| <a id="bundle"></a>bundle | Tag Bundle Clipboard: a set of tags copied from one entity to paste on others. |
| <a id="flag"></a>flag, unflagged | Scene Variants' flag tag, kept on every scene that has at least one other variant, so one tag filter lists them. |
| <a id="staging"></a>staging, stage | Holding changes for you to review rather than writing them - in Stash's edit form until you press Save, or in a plugin's dialog until you press Apply or Proceed. |
| <a id="chrome"></a>chrome | Stash's own interface around the page content - top bar, tab strips, toolbars - where these plugins add their controls. |
| <a id="namespace-marker"></a>namespace-marker | A character put in the names of the tags that only group other tags - the headings of a tag tree, never put on an entity - so one assigned by mistake stands out wherever it lands. A naming convention the name filters here make easy to use; Stash itself has no such notion. |

## Not used in the settings

Terms no setting or task description uses at the moment, still used in the READMEs.

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="sub-tag"></a>sub-tag | A tag's children in Stash's tag hierarchy. |
| <a id="auto-prune"></a>auto-prune, auto-roll-up | Prune and Roll-Up as auto-modes: done by Normalize Parent Tags on every save of an entity type set to them. |
| <a id="lease"></a>lease | The flag a plugin holds while it writes, so the others do not react to its writes. |
